Definition: to coo or chirp (as a bird)
BiblicalUsage: The Bible's word here is tsâphaph, meaning to coo or chirp. It appears 4 times in Scripture, including Isaiah 8:19 and Isaiah 38:14.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: tsâphaph matters because God said it, and God wastes no words.
